subject.title: Control UI: split screen mode — view two chat sessions side by side

question: Should Control UI add a first-class persisted multi-session split-pane chat workspace, and if so should the first version support arbitrary pane trees or a narrower two-pane MVP?
rationale: This is a new user-facing UI mode with persisted local layout state and active-session routing semantics, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not choose that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor arbitrary split panes
options.body: Define the pane tree model, persistence key, active-pane routing behavior, accessibility rules, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Start with two panes
options.body: Limit the initial scope to two side-by-side chat sessions to reduce state and responsive-layout complexity.

options.title: Keep browser tabs as the workflow
options.body: Decline or defer the feature if the added Control UI complexity is not worth replacing multiple browser tabs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor arbitrary split panes
recommendation.body: Define the pane tree model, persistence key, active-pane routing behavior, accessibility rules, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete filed the request and has strong historical chat-surface context, making him the best available product-direction owner from the sampled history.
